post.summary: Initiate prechecks execution on PPAN for complete deployment.
post.description:
Initiates prechecks execution on PPAN for complete deployment. It returns a precheck report id, which can be used to trigger patch rollback later. Patch rollback can happen in two modes :
  1. Full Patch Rollback -> Hostname needs to be an empty array. First patch will get installed on PPAN and then it will get installed on all other nodes parallelly.
  2. Sequential Patch Rollback -> Hostname needs to be an empty array. First patch will get installed on PPAN and then it will get installed on all other nodes sequentially.
upgradeType param can be specified as PATCH_ROLLBACK for full patch rollback, PATCH_ROLLBACK_SEQUENTIAL for sequential patch rollback. upgrade type is mandatory parameter.

post.summary: Trigger patch installation on the Cisco ISE nodes.
post.description:
Trigger patch installation on the Cisco ISE nodes.
  • In Full patch installation, patch will be installed on PPAN first, and then on following nodes.
  • In Split patch installation, patch will be installed on PPAN first, and then on the nodes in batches of the remaining iterations.
A task ID is returned which can be used to monitor the progress of the patch installation process. As the patch installation triggers the Cisco ISE to restart, the task API becomes unavailable for a certain period of time. When installation is going on PPAN, then monitor the progress on SPAN GUI.

post.summary: Initiate prechecks execution on PPAN for complete deployment.
post.description:
Initiates prechecks execution on PPAN for complete deployment. It returns a precheck report id, which can be used to trigger patch installation later. Patch installation can happen in three modes :
  1. Full Patch Installation -> Hostname needs to be an empty array. First patch will get installed on PPAN and then it will get installed on all other nodes parallelly.
  2. Sequential Patch Installation -> Hostname needs to be an empty array. First patch will get installed on PPAN and then it will get installed on all other nodes sequentially.
  3. Split -> This will happen in batches / iterations. Host name is mandatory. In first iteration only PPAN should be sent as part of hostname. Once the PPAN installation is successfull then remaining nodes can be sent in batches.
upgradeType param can be specified as FULL_PATCH for full patch installation, SPLIT_PATCH for split patch installation and SEQUENTIAL_PATCH for sequential patch installation. upgrade type, patch bundle name, repository name are mandatory parameters.
